summary: The GUARD Act of 2026 places federal rules and restrictions on entities that provide publicly available artificial intelligence chatbots and AI companions. It creates criminal penalties for exposing minors to sexual content or encouraging self-harm and violence via chatbots. It also requires age verification for accessing AI companions, mandates user accounts, prohibits minors from using AI companions, and requires AI chatbots to make specific disclosures about their non-human and non-professional status.

affected_groups.effect: They are prohibited from accessing AI companions, and protected by criminal prohibitions against exposure to sexually explicit material or encouragement of self-harm and violence via chatbots.

They must implement user accounts, age verification processes, data security measures, and specific conversation disclosures, under threat of civil penalties up to $250,000 per violation and criminal fines.
affected_groups.group: Covered entities (persons making artificial intelligence chatbots publicly available)

key_provisions: Makes it a federal crime punishable by fines up to $250,000 per offense to provide a chatbot that exposes minors to sexually explicit conduct or encourages minors to commit suicide, self-harm, unlawful violence, or homicide.
Prohibits minors from accessing or using AI companions.
Requires entities that provide AI companions to set up user accounts and enforce reasonable age verification processes using verified forms of identification or other approved methods.
Mandates that existing user accounts for AI companions be frozen on the effective date until age verification is complete, and requires periodic re-verification of accounts.
Prohibits covered entities from using third-party age verification providers connected to covered nations.

Requires all publicly available AI chatbots to disclose at the start of conversations and at regular intervals that they are artificial intelligence systems and not humans, and prohibits them from claiming to be human.
Requires all publicly available AI chatbots to disclose that they do not provide medical, legal, financial, or psychological services and that users should consult licensed professionals.

summary_detail.significance: The bill establishes federal oversight of artificial intelligence chatbots and companions by setting age-gating requirements, imposing criminal penalties for harmful chatbot content involving minors, and enforcing mandatory non-human disclosures, backed by civil and criminal fines up to $250,000.
